title.zh: OpenAI 28天产品冲刺Day16：Codex和Work缓存永久保留，API延长至12小时
title.en: OpenAI 28天产品冲刺Day16：Codex和Work缓存永久保留，API延长至12小时

current_state.zh: OpenAI's Day 16 sprint update makes prompt caching permanent for logged-in Codex and ChatGPT Work sessions and extends Responses API cache lifetime from 30 minutes to 12 hours, at 2.5x write cost with steep discounts on subsequent cache hits.
